ex: Tá mo **fhón póca** ar 1% arís — cá bhfuil an luchtaire?
exEn: My phone is on 1% again — where's the charger?
tip: After mo (my), fón becomes fhón: mo fhón.

ex: Tá **sceitimíní** orm faoin turas scoile!
exEn: I'm so excited about the school trip!
tip: Feelings sit 'on' you in Irish: Tá sceitimíní orm = I'm excited.

ex: Fuair mé ticéid don **cheolchoirm** sa 3Arena!
exEn: I got tickets for the gig in the 3Arena!
tip: ceol (music) + coirm (feast) = a feast of music.

ex: Cuir mé leis an **ngrúpa comhrá**!
exEn: Add me to the group chat!

ex: Tá **ocras** an domhain orm — an ordóimid píotsa?
exEn: I'm absolutely starving — will we order a pizza?
tip: Tá ocras orm = I'm hungry. 'An domhain' (of the world) makes it extreme.

ex: Is í Aoife mo **chara** is fearr.
exEn: Aoife is my best friend.
tip: mo chara is fearr = my best friend.

ex: Tá **traenáil** peile agam tar éis na scoile.
exEn: I have football training after school.
tip: traenáil peile / iománaíochta / cispheile = football / hurling / basketball training.

ex: Tógaimis **féinín** os comhair an stáitse!
exEn: Let's take a selfie in front of the stage!
tip: féin = self, so féinín is a 'little self'.

ex: Tá an rang seo chomh **leadránach** sin.
exEn: This class is so boring.
tip: chomh … sin = so …: chomh leadránach sin.

ex: Cad atá ar siúl agat an **deireadh seachtaine** seo?
exEn: What are you up to this weekend?

ex: Cad é **pasfhocal** an Wi-Fi?
exEn: What's the Wi-Fi password?

ex: An bhfaca tú an **scannán** nua Marvel fós?
exEn: Have you seen the new Marvel film yet?

ex: Bhí **náire** an domhain orm nuair a thit mé ar an stáitse.
exEn: I was mortified when I fell on the stage.

ex: An roinnfidh tú na **sceallóga** liom?
exEn: Will you share the chips with me?

ex: Bhí an **bua** againn sa chluiche ceannais!
exEn: We won the final!
tip: Bhí an bua againn = we won (literally 'we had the victory').

ex: Íoslódáil an **aip** seo — tá sí thar barr!
exEn: Download this app — it's brilliant!
tip: Aip is feminine, so 'it' is sí.

ex: Tá **cóisir** ag Seán Dé Sathairn — an bhfuil tú ag teacht?
exEn: Seán is having a party on Saturday — are you coming?

ex: Ná bí **buartha** — beidh tú go breá!
exEn: Don't worry — you'll be grand!

ex: Ní féidir liom an **t-amhrán** sin a bhaint as mo cheann!
exEn: I can't get that song out of my head!

ex: Níl aon **airgead** fágtha agam go dtí an Aoine.
exEn: I have no money left until Friday.

ex: D'fhéach mé ar an **tsraith** ar fad in aon deireadh seachtaine amháin.
exEn: I binged the whole series in one weekend.

ex: Bíodh **muinín** agat asat féin!
exEn: Believe in yourself!
tip: muinín a bheith agat as = to have confidence in.

ex: An imreoidh tú **cluiche** liom ar líne anocht?
exEn: Will you play a game with me online tonight?
tip: cluiche ceannais = final; ar líne = online.

ex: An féidir leat **rún** a choinneáil?
exEn: Can you keep a secret?

ex: Chonaic milliún duine an **físeán** sin ar TikTok!
exEn: A million people saw that video on TikTok!

ex: Nach mór an **faoiseamh** é — tá na scrúduithe thart!
exEn: What a relief — the exams are over!
tip: Nach mór an … é! = What a …!

ex: Tá mo chéad **cheacht tiomána** agam amárach!
exEn: I have my first driving lesson tomorrow!
tip: tiomáint = driving; ceadúnas tiomána = driving licence.

ex: Bhí **an-spraoi** againn ag Funderland!
exEn: We had great fun at Funderland!
tip: an- in front = great / very: an-spraoi.

ex: Chaill mé mo **chluasáin** arís!
exEn: I lost my earphones again!

ex: Tá **fearg** orm — chaill mé an bus arís!
exEn: I'm raging — I missed the bus again!

ex: Tá mé ar **fhoireann** na scoile anois!
exEn: I'm on the school team now!
tip: foireann na scoile = the school team.

ex: Bhí an-chraic againn sa **Ghaeltacht** an samhradh seo caite!
exEn: We had great craic in the Gaeltacht last summer!

ex: Táim chomh **tuirseach** sin — d'fhan mé i mo dhúiseacht go dtí a trí!
exEn: I'm so tired — I stayed up until three!

ex: Tá mo **ríomhaire glúine** chomh mall le seilide!
exEn: My laptop is as slow as a snail!

ex: Tá **cairdeas** níos tábhachtaí ná rud ar bith.
exEn: Friendship matters more than anything.

ex: Tá **scrúdú** Gaeilge againn amárach — guigh ádh orm!
exEn: We have an Irish exam tomorrow — wish me luck!
tip: Plural: scrúduithe. An Ardteist = the Leaving Cert.

ex: Bhí brionglóid chomh **haisteach** agam aréir!
exEn: I had such a weird dream last night!

ex: **Ádh** mór ort sa chluiche amárach!
exEn: Best of luck in the match tomorrow!

ex: Seol na **grianghraif** ón gcóisir chugam!
exEn: Send me the photos from the party!

ex: Bhí **díomá** orm nuair a cuireadh an cheolchoirm ar ceal.
exEn: I was gutted when the gig was cancelled.

ex: Ba bhreá liom **taisteal** timpeall na hEorpa an samhradh seo chugainn.
exEn: I'd love to travel around Europe next summer.
tip: Ba bhreá liom … = I'd love to …

ex: Seol **téacs** chugam nuair a bheidh tú taobh amuigh.
exEn: Text me when you're outside.
tip: téacs a sheoladh = to send a text.

ex: Bhí an cluiche aréir go **hiontach**!
exEn: The match last night was amazing!
tip: After tá / bhí use go: go hiontach.

ex: Téim chuig an seomra **aclaíochta** trí huaire sa tseachtain.
exEn: I go to the gym three times a week.

ex: Fuair mé **post páirtaimseartha** i gcaifé!
exEn: I got a part-time job in a café!

ex: Bím ag éisteacht le **ceol** ar an mbus gach maidin.
exEn: I listen to music on the bus every morning.
tip: Bím = I'm usually / I regularly am.

ex: Rinne mé **dearmad** ar m'obair bhaile arís!
exEn: I forgot my homework again!
tip: Rinne mé dearmad ar … = I forgot …

ex: Tá míle **leantóir** aici anois!
exEn: She has a thousand followers now!
tip: After míle the noun stays singular.

ex: **Breithlá** sona duit — ocht mbliana déag inniu!
exEn: Happy birthday — eighteen today!

ex: Teastaíonn **sos** uaim ón staidéar.
exEn: I need a break from study.
